integrity: Exact simplicial relative collapse proof; small-case exhaustive checker; no claim of computational proof for the infinite family.
scientific_limitations: Only two-independence on depth-three rooted trees with m>=2, each s_i>=2, q_ij>=2. Uniform-tree ambient contractibility is previously known; novel scope is irregular root-link inclusion equivalence and local profile. No independent priority or scientific validation.
title: Root-puncture homotopy equivalence in depth-three three-path-free tree complexes
